root_cause.summary: Database reconciliation and daily watchdog logic could retroactively downgrade already provider-created social posts because later readback, auth, admin or media-proof checks failed.
causes: post-provider reconciliation reused pre-provider verification gates
daily terminal success ignored durable provider-created PUBLISHED social side effects
verification subsystems were allowed to overwrite provider side-effect truth

prevention_rules: Durable external ID plus provider_create_success/provider_publication_ack_verified/provider_truth_verified plus republish_forbidden is a terminal social side-effect fence.
Provider-created LinkedIn and Instagram posts remain PUBLISHED even when later readback/admin/media-proof calls fail.
Pre-publish identity/media gates may block before provider write, never after a successful provider side effect.
Daily watchdog and daily assertion count provider-created PUBLISHED social obligations as terminal success.
Any recovery after provider create is exact-ID reconciliation only and can never issue a replacement post.

outcome.intended_state: Every provider-created daily social post is protected from false failure reclassification and duplicate recovery.
